result.summary: The image depicts a standard urban intersection with marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and sidewalks on both sides. The environment features mixed-use buildings and street trees, though visibility for pedestrians is partially hindered by parked vehicles near the crossing.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the right side of the street are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: The asphalt within and near the crosswalk shows signs of wear and patching, which could be a tripping hazard or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking in the daylighting zone.

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and smooth the road surface in the intersection to ensure a safe and accessible path for all users.

result.summary: A residential urban intersection featuring marked zebra crosswalks and curb ramps with tactile paving. The environment is generally pedestrian-friendly due to narrow street geometry and mature street trees, though it lacks dedicated pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: While there is a traffic light for vehicles, no dedicated pedestrian signal is visible to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the traffic light pole.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear guidance on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a mixed-use urban intersection featuring marked zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure is present, a large delivery truck stopped near the crossing creates a significant visual obstruction for both pedestrians and motorists.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Large Vehicle
hazards.description: A large white truck is stopped immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, blocking sightlines between pedestrians entering the roadway and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center-left, positioned just before the marked crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and prevent vehicles from parking too close to the crosswalk, improving visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk through paint and bollards to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The image depicts a well-equipped urban intersection featuring high-visibility continental crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. The presence of mature street trees and 'No Turn On Red' signage enhances the pedestrian environment by providing shade and reducing vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Turning vehicle conflicts
hazards.description: Vehicles turning onto the street may conflict with pedestrians in the crosswalk, despite the 'No Turn On Red' restriction for the opposing direction.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and increase the visibility of pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Implement a signal timing change that allows pedestrians to begin crossing several seconds before parallel vehicle traffic is given a green light.
